learned: 2026-10-05, by an agent pass: 21 entries in one JS file (window.CC_STRAINS, a JS object literal with comments and unquoted keys). The pages render it client-side; products.html has only format prose. The file's header says it is sourced from NY dispensary menus.
notes: Each entry is name (the strain), category (Flower, Dime Bag, Pre-Roll, Infused, Vape, Gummies) and format ('3.5g Jar', '.7g Pouch', '1g Pre-Roll', '1g Infused Pre-Roll', '1g Live Cart', 'Nighttime · 20-pack'). Size comes from format; meta is the thc field, which for gummies is the pack's dose ('100mg').

Lines are the brand's own names from products.html: 'Liquid Gold' for the infused pre-rolls, 'Live Resin' for the carts ('1g live-resin carts'), and Nighttime / Daytime for the gummies (5mg THC each, 20 to a tin).
A dime bag is the same flower in a .7g pouch, so it is flower; White Widow and Pineapple Express appear in two formats.
products.html says pre-rolls also come in 5-pack boxes, but the data has no 5-pack entries; those come from the stores.

Check on 2026-10-05: 21 entries; stores sell 19 products, 13 found. The 6 store-only (Blue Zushi flower and pack, Bomb Pop, Caramel Apple infused, Strawberry Diesel dime bag, a Sour Diesel 3g pack) are not in the data.
